about: Test vectors for the libzync chain-proof verifier (swiftsync-verify, its C ABI and WASM), engine (OpenVM) proofs only since the cutover (27.11.2026). Each case gives the verifier arguments (swiftsync-verify syntax) and the exit code a correct verifier must give: 0 OK, 2 DEMO, 1 FAIL. mainnet_1_200_engine.hze is the engine chain's real proof of mainnet 1..200 (swiftsync-verify/tests/data/engine200), with its image id and verifying key (.vk, pinned by the caller with --vk-sha256: no engine image is published yet, and a key is never pinned to itself, review R1-6 #1); make_vectors.py writes every file here from it. `cli_only` cases test the CLI's argument handling and are skipped by the C and WASM harnesses.

cases.name: mainnet_1_200_demo
cases.description: The engine chain's proof of mainnet 1..200 under its image and pinned key: valid, but below Core's minimum chainwork, so DEMO.

cases.name: mainnet_1_200_as_signet
cases.description: The same proof checked as signet: refused (another network's genesis and profile).

cases.name: other_image_id
cases.description: The same proof against another image id: refused (the image id is SHA-256 of the exe and the VM config).

cases.name: no_image_given
cases.description: No image id or key: no engine image is published yet, so there is nothing to check against: refused.

cases.name: key_flipped
cases.description: A verifying key with one bit flipped (its last byte), pinned as given: refused (the image id is recomputed from the key).

cases.name: proof_flipped
cases.description: One bit flipped inside the proof (byte 1008): refused.

cases.name: journal_flipped
cases.description: One bit flipped in the journal (40 bytes from the end): refused (the public values are SHA-256 of the journal).

cases.name: trailing_byte
cases.description: A zero byte appended: refused (it becomes part of the journal, which is then not whole words and not the committed one).

cases.name: truncated
cases.description: Cut halfway through the proof: refused, no panic.

cases.name: length_past_end
cases.description: A proof length field of 0xffffffff: refused, no panic.

cases.name: time_too_new
cases.description: The clock set back to the genesis time: block 200's time is more than 2 h ahead of it: refused.

cases.name: bundle
cases.description: A version-2 bundle of the proof (swiftsync-verify bundle): its header equals the verified result: DEMO.

cases.name: bundle_header_lies
cases.description: The bundle with its stop height changed to 201: refused.

cases.name: bundle_v1
cases.description: The bundle marked version 1 (that version carried a hints-file hash): refused.

cases.name: hints_arg_refused
cases.description: A hints-file argument (the retired design B): the CLI refuses it rather than ignore it.

cases.name: dash_arg_refused
cases.description: The old '-' (no hints file) argument: refused.

cases.name: mainnet_1_200_key_unpinned
cases.description: The real proof and key, but no --vk-sha256: refused (a key is never pinned to itself, review R1-6 #1).

cases.name: mainnet_1_200_key_wrong_pin
cases.description: The real proof and key with a pin that is not the key file's SHA-256: refused before anything is decoded.

coin_log_mainnet_200.about: The engine chain's verified state at mainnet height 200 (node format 2): utxo_leaves, utxo_value and the coin forest roots by index (ChainState.utxo_roots).

status: Rebuilt on the engine proof at the cutover (27.11.2026, engine/CUTOVER.md C2); the RISC Zero receipts went with the RISC Zero front (v0.27.1's verifier checks them).
